A small gallery -- click any image to open the full-size version.

::: {.photo-grid}

```{python}
#| output: asis
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path

EXTS = {".jpg", ".jpeg", ".png", ".gif", ".webp"}

page_candidates = [Path("."), Path("pages/Photos")]
page_dir = next(
    (
        p
        for p in page_candidates
        if (p / "photos.json").exists() or (p / "photography").exists()
    ),
    Path("."),
)

manifest_path = page_dir / "photos.json"
source_dir = page_dir / "photography"
web_dir = page_dir / "photography_derived" / "web"
thumb_dir = page_dir / "photography_derived" / "thumbs"

manifest = {}
manifest_asset_base = ""
if manifest_path.exists():
    manifest = json.loads(manifest_path.read_text())
    if isinstance(manifest, list):
        image_entries = manifest
    else:
        image_entries = manifest.get("images", [])
        manifest_asset_base = manifest.get("asset_base", "")
else:
    if not source_dir.exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError("Could not locate photos directory or photos.json")
    image_entries = [
        {"file": p.name}
        for p in sorted(source_dir.iterdir())
        if p.is_file() and p.suffix.lower() in EXTS
    ]

asset_base = os.environ.get("PHOTO_ASSET_BASE", manifest_asset_base).strip()
if asset_base:
    asset_base = asset_base.rstrip("/") + "/"


def as_page_relative(path):
    try:
        return path.relative_to(page_dir).as_posix()
    except ValueError:
        pass

    parts = path.as_posix().split("pages/Photos/", 1)
    if len(parts) == 2:
        return parts[1]
    return path.as_posix()


def asset_url(path):
    path = path.as_posix() if isinstance(path, Path) else str(path)
    if path.startswith(("http://", "https://", "/")):
        return path
    return f"{asset_base}{path}"


tiles = []
for entry in image_entries:
    entry = {"file": entry} if isinstance(entry, str) else entry
    filename = entry["file"]

    image = source_dir / filename
    web_image = web_dir / filename
    thumb_image = thumb_dir / filename

    full = Path("photography_derived/web") / filename
    preview = Path("photography_derived/thumbs") / filename

    if web_image.exists():
        full = as_page_relative(web_image)
    elif image.exists():
        full = as_page_relative(image)

    if thumb_image.exists():
        preview = as_page_relative(thumb_image)
    elif web_image.exists():
        preview = as_page_relative(web_image)
    elif image.exists():
        preview = as_page_relative(image)

    alt = entry.get("title", Path(filename).stem.replace("_", " ").strip())
    title = alt.replace('"', "&quot;")
    preview_path = asset_url(preview)
    full_path = asset_url(full)

    tiles.append(
        f'[![]({preview_path})]({full_path}){{.lightbox group=\"photo-gallery\" title=\"{title}\"}}'
    )

print("\n\n".join(tiles))
```
